import ldap3

app = Flask(__name__)

@app.route("/normal")
def normal():
    dc = request.args.get("dc")
    username = request.args.get("username")

    query = f"(&(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)(sAMAccountName={username}))"

    server = ldap3.Server("localhost", port=389, get_info=ldap3.ALL)
    conn = ldap3.Connection(server, user=f"CN={username},{dc}", password="password")
    conn.bind()

    conn.search(query)
    results = conn.entries

    return results
